title: Who will be the next James Bond?

paragraphs: Reports indicate that final auditions are currently underway to select the next James Bond. Actors Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor, and Callum Turner emerge as top contenders.

Screen tests are reportedly evaluating finalists across three critical criteria: stunt capabilities, dialogue performance, and overall screen presence. Industry analysts highlight Jack Lowden as the current betting favorite and note his potential for a dramatic character transformation. Meanwhile, Josh O’Connor brings acclaimed dramatic experience, and Callum Turner offers a classic, retro aesthetic. Experts also suggest that studio executives might still surprise audiences by choosing an unexpected actor, such as Jacob Elordi.
The rigorous selection process aims to ensure the new 007 appeals to a global audience under Amazon MGM Studios, with an official announcement expected around Christmas.
